entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Unstable ScrollToPosition.End on Windows #32945
  • Runtime error when closing external window with WPF Webview Control #32944
  • Label Overlapped by Android Status Bar When Using SafeAreaEdges="Container" in .NET MAUI #32941
  • App crash only on release if use FormattedText of Label component in .xaml #32934
  • CollectionView does not show an EmptyView template with an empty collection #32932
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [iOS] SearchHandler suggestions list does not follow the search bar upward movement on iPhone, creating a layout gap #32930
  • [UI Tests] Test crashes with "Java.Lang.IllegalArgumentException: parameter must be a descendant of this view" #32927
  • Slider thumb lags behind finger on iOS 26+ #32926
    .NET 10.0 SR3

Closed

  • Opening a dialog in the event handler of AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException is not possible, #32942
  • [Android] MediaPicker stops working after lauching other ComponentActivity. #32845
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • IServiceProvider is disposed with new Maui Project @ Android #32750
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • File Selector for iOS silently fails when app compiled in Release configuration. Succeeds when compiled in Debug configuration. #32887
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • Editor TextChanged event not firing on ios 26.1 release build (but does in debug mode) #32651
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • ListView is not working #32938
  • CollectionView not working #32937
  • Button doesn't work #32936
  • [Windows] Shell header is not visible because It's merged with page graphics #14468
  • [Android] ListView items disappear and reappear randomly when removing items from the list #20046
    Backlog
  • [XSG] RelativeSource binding with FindAncestorBindingContext does not work #32924
  • I4_ Selection - Selected items are not highlighted in orange #32414
    Backlog
  • [.NET10]The 'My recipes' page behaves differently when scrolling horizontally on Mac catalyst and iOS, and newly created and added recipes don’t show up in "my recipes" list on Mac #32763

PullRequests

Created

  • Add triage-agent custom agent for repository triage #32949
  • [Android] Fix ShellFlyout footer area not cleared after removing footer view #32948
  • Add tests for CSS styles with IsEnabled=false #32947
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Fix XamlC to respect ObsoleteAttribute message and isError parameter #32946
    area-xaml, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [XSG] Fix CS8601 error in XAML SourceGen setter for nullable reference types #32940
    area-xaml, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [C] Fix Slider and Stepper property order independence #32939
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • Feature/intelligent UI test execution #32935
  • Fix iOS SearchHandler suggestions list gap on iPhone #32931
  • [Android] Fix SwipeGestureRecognizer not firing on CollectionView/ListView #32928

Merged

  • [net11.0] Fix build errors: qualify handler types and resolve merge conflicts #32933
  • [iOS] Fix for Unable to Update iOS SwipeGesture Direction at Runtime #30165
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-gestures, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [Issue-Resolver] Fix TabBar visibility on macOS 26 (Tahoe) #32910
    platform/macos, p/0, area-controls-shell, area-controls-tabbedpage, community ✨, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Android, iOS, Mac] Fix inconsistent Background vs BackgroundColor behavior in CollectionView selection with VSM #32669
    platform/android, platform/ios, area-controls-collectionview, collectionview-cv2, partner/syncfusion, collectionview-cv1, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [iOS] Fixed Current Item change on Device Orientation #32672
    platform/ios, area-controls-collectionview, community ✨, collectionview-cv2, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Fix iOS WebView Navigating event not triggered for target="_blank" links #32199
    area-controls-webview, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Android] Prevent CollectionView SelectionChanged from triggering on SwipeView gesture #30652
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [XSG] Fix RelativeSource binding with FindAncestorBindingContext mode #32925
    area-xaml

Updated

  • [Android] Fix WebView in a grid expands beyond it's cell #32145
    platform/android, p/0, community ✨, area-controls-webview, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Android] Fixed Shell Colors Do Not Update Correctly When Switching Between TabBar Items #32882
    platform/android, area-controls-shell, partner/syncfusion
  • [net11.0] Use ElementHandlerAttribute instead of DI for built-in visual elements #29952
    platform/macos, platform/windows, platform/android, platform/ios, area-architecture, .NET 11 Planning
  • [XSG] Improve diagnostic reporting during binding compilation #32905
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • Inflight/current #29755
    platform/macos, platform/windows, platform/android, platform/ios, area-infrastructure
  • Fix the OnNavigatedTo event and the OnAppearing event to return the ScrollToAsync method call #16619
    community ✨, stale, area-controls-scrollview, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [iOS] SearchHandler overlaps title and title view - fix #30772
    platform/ios, community ✨, shell-search-handler, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [iOS] Fixed Webview LoadFile ignore directories. #31040
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [iOS]Fix: GestureRecognizer Prevents Focus & User Interaction on Input Controls #28124
    platform/ios, community ✨, area-gestures, partner/syncfusion/review
